import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); I=G['Demo pair 1 input']; O=G['Demo pair 1 output']; T=G['Test input']
def f(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    coltops={c:min(r for r,row in enumerate(g) for cc,x in enumerate(row) if x==c) for c in set(x for row in g for x in row)-{0}}
    top=min(coltops.values())
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for c,col in coltops.items():
        cells=[(r,cc) for r,row in enumerate(g) for cc,x in enumerate(row) if x==c]
        for r,cc in cells: out[r-(col-top)][cc]=c
    return out
print(f(I)==O)
R=f(T)
show=lambda g:[print(''.join(str(x) if x else '.' for x in row)) for row in g]
print("RES"); show(R)
